headline: New singlepass compiler 70% faster than wazero, compiles 5x faster, uses 11x less memory
summary: A new singlepass compiler promises major performance gains over existing solutions like wazero, offering significant speed and memory efficiency improvements for developers.
details: A new singlepass compiler has been introduced, claiming significant performance improvements over existing solutions. It is reportedly 70% faster than wazero, offering a substantial boost in execution speed.
Beyond execution, the compiler also boasts a 5x faster compilation time. Furthermore, it is said to utilize 11x less memory, making it highly efficient for resource-constrained environments.

headline: Thelio Mira AI Linux Workstation offers 192 GB GPU Memory for local AI development
summary: System76's new Thelio Mira AI workstation is built for local AI development, allowing users to train and fine-tune challenging AI workloads entirely on their own hardware.
details: System76 has launched the Thelio Mira AI, a new Linux workstation designed for intensive local AI development. This powerful machine boasts an impressive 192 GB of GPU memory, enabling users to train, fine-tune, and iterate challenging AI workloads directly on their hardware.

The workstation is positioned as an affordable solution for AI developers seeking dedicated local processing power. It aims to provide the necessary resources to handle complex AI tasks without relying on external cloud services.
System76 hardware products come with flexible warranty options, including 1-year, 2-year, or 3-year limited product warranties. Batteries and chargers are covered for one year.

For international customers, System76 notes that it does not calculate or collect international taxes, duties, or brokerage fees at checkout. Additionally, shipping costs for international warranty repairs are not covered by the company.
